scenarios.title: A difficult situation
scenarios.prompt: Tell me about a difficult situation you faced at work and how you handled it.
scenarios.promptPersian: از یک موقعیت دشوار کاری بگویید و اینکه چطور آن را مدیریت کردید.

starHints.situation: Where were you working, and what made the situation genuinely difficult?
starHints.task: What exactly were YOU responsible for resolving?
starHints.action: The 2-3 concrete steps you personally took — not what 'the team' did.
starHints.result: What happened in the end? A number or observable change is best.

usefulPhrases: The situation was...
My responsibility was to...
The first thing I did was...
As a result,...

scenarios.title: Conflict with a colleague
scenarios.prompt: Describe a time you had a conflict or disagreement with a colleague. How did you resolve it?
scenarios.promptPersian: از زمانی بگویید که با همکاری اختلاف داشتید. چطور حلش کردید؟

starHints.situation: A professional disagreement — technical choice, process, priorities. Not personal gossip.
starHints.task: Why did it matter that this got resolved?
starHints.action: How you approached THEM: listening first, finding shared goals, involving data.
starHints.result: The resolution AND the state of the working relationship afterwards.

usefulPhrases: We saw it differently...
I asked him/her to walk me through their reasoning...
We agreed to...
In the end we actually...

scenarios.title: Making a mistake
scenarios.prompt: Tell me about a mistake you made at work. What did you do about it?
scenarios.promptPersian: از اشتباهی که در کار کردید بگویید. چه کردید؟

starHints.situation: A real mistake with real consequences — small enough to be safe, real enough to be credible.
starHints.task: What was at risk because of your mistake?
starHints.action: Owning it fast, fixing it, telling the right people. The order matters.
starHints.result: The fix + the permanent change in how you work.

usefulPhrases: I made the wrong call on...

scenarios.title: Receiving negative feedback
scenarios.prompt: Tell me about a time you received negative feedback. How did you respond?
scenarios.promptPersian: از زمانی بگویید که بازخورد منفی گرفتید. چه واکنشی نشان دادید؟

starHints.situation: Feedback that stung — from a manager, peer, or review.
starHints.task: What did you need to change or prove?
starHints.action: How you processed it (not defensively) and the concrete behavior change.
starHints.result: Evidence the feedback-giver noticed the change.

usefulPhrases: At first it was hard to hear...

scenarios.title: Working under pressure
scenarios.prompt: Describe a time you had to work under significant pressure or a tight deadline.
scenarios.promptPersian: از زمانی بگویید که زیر فشار زیاد یا ضرب‌الاجل فشرده کار کردید.

starHints.situation: What created the pressure — deadline, outage, understaffing?
starHints.task: What had to be delivered, by when?
starHints.action: Prioritization, cutting scope, communicating early — your actual coping moves.
starHints.result: Delivered or not — and what the honest outcome taught you.

scenarios.title: Competing priorities
scenarios.prompt: Tell me about a time you had to manage several competing priorities.
scenarios.promptPersian: از زمانی بگویید که چند اولویت هم‌زمان را مدیریت کردید.

starHints.situation: Several genuinely important things at once — who wanted what?
starHints.task: Why couldn't everything be done at once? What was the constraint?
starHints.action: How you ranked them (impact, deadlines, stakeholders) and SAID NO or negotiated.
starHints.result: What got done, what got moved, and how stakeholders reacted.

usefulPhrases: Three things landed on me at once...

scenarios.title: Solving a hard problem
scenarios.prompt: Walk me through a difficult problem you solved. What was your approach?

starHints.situation: A problem that resisted the obvious fix.
starHints.task: Why did it land on you, and what did success look like?
starHints.action: Your reasoning process: narrowing down, experiments, eliminating causes.
starHints.result: The solution, plus what it prevented or saved going forward.

scenarios.title: A difficult colleague
scenarios.prompt: Have you ever worked with a difficult person? How did you make it work?
scenarios.promptPersian: آیا با فرد دشواری کار کرده‌اید؟ چطور همکاری را پیش بردید؟

starHints.situation: Difficult HOW — uncommunicative, dominating, always negative? Stay respectful.
starHints.task: Why did you have to make it work (shared project, dependency)?
starHints.action: Adapting your communication, setting boundaries, finding their strengths.
starHints.result: A working relationship — doesn't need a friendship ending.

usefulPhrases: We had very different working styles...

scenarios.prompt: Tell me about a time you took responsibility for something beyond your role.

starHints.situation: A gap nobody owned — a failing process, an orphaned system, an ignored risk.
starHints.task: Why did it matter, and why did you step up?
starHints.action: What you did without being asked — and how you kept your actual job on track.
starHints.result: The outcome and what it changed about how people saw you.

starHints.task: What were you trying to achieve?
starHints.action: What you tried, and honestly where it went wrong.

starHints.situation: An idea others initially resisted or ignored.
starHints.task: What decision needed to change?

starHints.situation: A reorg, cancelled project, pivot, or sudden new priority.

scenarios.prompt: Tell me about a time you helped a struggling teammate.

starHints.situation: A teammate behind, blocked, or new — without making them look bad.
starHints.task: What was at stake for the team?
starHints.action: HOW you helped: pairing, unblocking, covering — respectfully.
starHints.result: Their progress plus the team outcome.

usefulPhrases: I noticed he/she was stuck on...

scenarios.title: A tight deadline you missed
scenarios.prompt: Tell me about a deadline you missed. What happened?
scenarios.promptPersian: از ضرب‌الاجلی بگویید که از دستش دادید. چه شد؟

starHints.situation: A real miss — rare and honest beats fake perfection.
starHints.task: The commitment and why it slipped.
starHints.action: When you knew, who you told, how you re-planned. Early communication is the hero.
starHints.result: The damage control and the process change afterwards.

scenarios.title: Going above and beyond
scenarios.prompt: Describe a time you went above and beyond for a project or customer.

starHints.situation: Why normal effort wasn't going to be enough.
starHints.task: What was the minimum expected — so the 'beyond' is measurable.
starHints.action: The extra steps, and (importantly) why they were worth it, not just heroics.
starHints.result: Impact on the customer/project + any recognition.

scenarios.prompt: Tell me about a decision you made without having all the information.
scenarios.promptPersian: از تصمیمی بگویید که بدون اطلاعات کامل گرفتید.

starHints.situation: Time pressure + missing data — a genuinely uncertain call.
starHints.task: What decision couldn't wait?
starHints.action: How you bounded the risk: reversible steps, assumptions stated, quick validation.
starHints.result: The outcome and what the decision process taught you.

scenarios.prompt: Give me an example of a process you improved. What was the impact?

starHints.situation: A slow, error-prone or annoying process everyone tolerated.
starHints.task: What pain did it cause, in time or quality?
starHints.action: Your change — and how you got people to actually adopt it.
starHints.result: Before/after, ideally with a number.

usefulPhrases: Everyone just accepted that releases took...

scenarios.title: Handling an unhappy customer
scenarios.prompt: Tell me about a time you dealt with an unhappy customer or stakeholder.
scenarios.promptPersian: از زمانی بگویید که با مشتری یا ذی‌نفع ناراضی سروکار داشتید.

starHints.situation: Who was unhappy and what was the real complaint under the anger?
starHints.task: What did you need to restore — the issue AND the trust?
starHints.action: Listening fully, owning what was yours, concrete fixes with dates.
starHints.result: The relationship afterwards — retained, calmer, referenceable?

usefulPhrases: They were frustrated because...

scenarios.prompt: Describe a time you mentored someone or taught a skill to a colleague.

starHints.situation: Who, and what gap were they facing?
starHints.task: What did they need to be able to do?
starHints.action: Your teaching approach — pairing, gradual ownership, honest feedback.
starHints.result: Their independence; what you learned about teaching.

usefulPhrases: A junior joined with no experience in...

scenarios.title: Disagreeing with a manager
scenarios.prompt: Tell me about a time you disagreed with your manager's decision.
scenarios.promptPersian: از زمانی بگویید که با تصمیم مدیرتان مخالف بودید.

starHints.situation: A professional disagreement about direction, priority or approach.
starHints.task: Why was it worth the discomfort of pushing back?
starHints.action: How you disagreed: privately, with evidence, offering alternatives — then committing to the final call.
starHints.result: Either you changed the decision, or you committed fully — both are good stories if handled well.

usefulPhrases: I thought the approach was risky because...
